The '''Bosph sector''' was a remote [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Planets in Bosph sector included [[Bendone]], [[Harrandarr]], [[Otunia]] and [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]] itself.

==History==
The sector was ruled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harsh]], who was appointed by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after his exemplary effort at the [[Battle of Chabosh (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Chabosh]].
